Kay Dean runs Fake Review Watch. She has spent years documenting businesses that trade, buy, & fake reviews, & her work has been covered by the New York Times, TIME, SFGate, NBC Bay Area, & Reveal. The New York Attorney General's office thanked her by name in October 2023 for helping an investigation into a practice posting fake reviews.

She sent me screenshots she captured in 2019 & 2020. In this video she walks me through them. The findings & the conclusions are hers. I am showing you her records & letting her explain what she concluded from them.

What her screenshots show, with the dates printed on them:

An account bearing the name Joshua Gulmatico posting in a Facebook group called "Exchange Google & Facebook Review": "Need google/yelp review. Exchange only. I have strong profile on both platform." Kay Dean dates that activity to 2019.

A Yel
